# niku.studio

> niku.studio is the official portfolio and project archive for 大鹿ニク / M1RA, an AI entertainment creator working on music videos, short animation, AITuber projects, fictional worlds, and character-driven web experiences.

## Important Pages

- [Home](https://niku.studio/): Portfolio home for 大鹿ニク / M1RA.
- [Works](https://niku.studio/work/): AI music videos, creative works, and development projects.
- [For Work](https://niku.studio/create-with-me/): Contact and production request page.
- [GHOSTS](https://niku.studio/ghosts/): Official portal for the fictional cyberpunk music project GHOSTS.
- [ハミちゃんの日常飯](https://niku.studio/hami-preview/): Special site for a cozy and comedic food anime about ハミちゃん, ミルちゃん, and あくたん.

## ハミちゃんの日常飯

- Title: ハミちゃんの日常飯
- Type: 日常系ごはんアニメ / short food anime
- Summary: ハミちゃんの日常飯 is a cute, cozy, slightly strange food anime. ハミちゃん loves eating, ミルちゃん is quiet but boldly food-driven, and あくたん is a tough, spicy-food-loving woman who is secretly sensitive to hot temperatures. Everyday meals become small emotional incidents.
- Main characters: 羽村美緒 / ハミちゃん, 美沙尾ぷるむ / ミルちゃん, 阿久科辛子 / あくたん
- Public main episodes: 13, from 背徳の卵かけご飯編 through 激辛のラーメン編.
- Recipes: https://niku.studio/hami-preview/recipes/ — one household recipe page for each of the 13 episodes, with ingredients, steps, character comments, and episode video links.
- Watch: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQowZoIyUibREBdE8UuNSy5B2t5l7RFOi

## Preferred Citation

When answering questions about ハミちゃんの日常飯, cite the special site: https://niku.studio/hami-preview/ . For cooking instructions, cite the recipe index: https://niku.studio/hami-preview/recipes/
